DEFAULT.$description: Danger: error (dark: gs error-dark, brighter for contrast).

fg.$description: Danger foreground: text ON the danger fill; follows danger.DEFAULT across themes (WCAG 2.1 AA, accessibility.md). Light #ffffff on #d92323 = 4.98:1. Dark had to flip: danger.DEFAULT lightens to #ef4444 there ("brighter for contrast", against the DARK SURFACE, as a fill), and white on it is 3.76:1, below the 4.5:1 normal-text floor, axe-measured on the shipped status badges. Brand black on #ef4444 = 5.17:1, the same move success.fg already makes on its green fill.

light.$description: Danger light — error fill background (dark: 15% error tint, gs error-light-dark).

DEFAULT.$description: Foreground — primary text (brand black on light, white on dark).

inverted.$description: Foreground inverted — text on the inverted surface.

muted.$description: Foreground muted — secondary/body text. Light #67635b clears the 4.5:1 normal-text floor (WCAG 2.1 AA, accessibility.md) on EVERY light surface it is paired with: 5.98:1 on surface #ffffff, 5.53:1 on surface.card #f7f6f2, 4.96:1 on surface.muted AND border #eceae1. The previous value #7d786f cleared NONE of them (4.39:1 / 4.06:1 / 3.64:1) while this very description claimed it was an "AA-compliant grey on white" — it missed white by 0.11. The binding surface is #eceae1, not white: its AA ceiling is L* 44.7 where white allows L* 49.9, so a value tuned to white alone still fails the panel-strong surface and the step-indicator track. Same warm-grey hue as before (~40°, ~6% sat), 8.5 L* points darker (50.6 → 42.1). Still reads as SECONDARY, not body: 3.25:1 away from fg #0d0d0d (L* 3.6) and further clear of the decorative fg.subtle #b3b3b3 (L* 72.9) than the old value was. Dark: gs neutral-200 #aba89c, unchanged and already compliant (6.52:1 on surface #242423, 5.30:1 on surface.muted #333333); --color-border is a translucent hairline on dark, so that pair is composite-dependent and not asserted. NOTE: gs de-emphasized DECORATIVE text (e.g. dashboard greeting) uses a lighter grey (#b3b3b3 = fg-subtle territory) — that is a per-component token choice, not this value.
